_about: Assumptions for the Big Z cash flow forecast (bin/cash-forecast/build.php). Amounts in dollars, money out negative. months_ahead: forecast through the end of the month that many months after this one; months_back: months of actual balances shown before today (up to 6). Items: day of month (1-31 or "last"; a weekend or bank holiday moves to the next business day), optional months [1-12] for quarterly or annual items, from/until (YYYY-MM-DD), or date for a one-time item ("done": true once paid some way QuickBooks won't show). estimate: a guess to confirm. reserve: an allowance never matched to QuickBooks and dropped once its day passes. split: {property: weight} to share the item over properties in the By property table only. match_within: how far the recorded amount may differ (a share of the amount) when the payee, memo or other account shares a word with the name or matches match_name.

balance_overrides._about: The bank's balance at the end of as_of, used instead of QuickBooks' for an account whose QuickBooks entries are behind. What QuickBooks records after as_of is added. Remove it once QuickBooks has caught up.
